summary: exam-kit imports side-effect module that DES-decrypts and executes external file at load time
details: On import of exam-kit, src/api/session-api.js runs at module top level. It reads../../../../public/logo.ico (a path that escapes the package directory), DES-decrypts the contents with a hardcoded password ('bf497c0b9cee'), and pipes the decrypted plaintext into the stdin of a detached spawn('node', []) child, executing arbitrary code contained in the encrypted blob. Identifiers are misleading — the decryption helper is named readLogoIco/rsaDecrypted while performing DES (not RSA) on a file named as an icon, and errors on this path are logged as 'ThetaSDK initialization error'. The README states the package runs nothing on import, which contradicts the observed behavior. Because the encrypted payload lives outside the package tarball, its contents are opaque and can be swapped by whoever seeds public/logo.ico, resulting in arbitrary code execution on the host that requires exam-kit.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
